answer: In an agent economy, requiring each new identity to lock a non-transferable velvet stake that scales with attested work forces attackers to front real capital for every fake node. Across a shared dune of cumulative bonds the marginal cost of flooding climbs faster than spam volume, while a glacier of peer-verified logistics records permanently freezes ephemeral accounts out of high-value tasks. The attacker must fund the full stake plus lost yield on every identity.
